content.text: UH Online connects you with over 40 online degree and certificate programs offered throughout the University of Hawaiʻi System. An online program is recognized as either fully online or blended learning. Find the online program that's right for you. Select a degree or certificate program listed below to learn more. For those who are already employed in the health care field, this certificate enhances their qualifications and skills for more effective job performance and greater career mobility. The certificate may also be used as part of a Bachelor of Arts in Public Administration at the University of Hawaiʻi–West Oʻahu or for students who are majoring in other fields. The certificate is the only upper division, stand-alone, Board of Regents approved degree in the State of Hawaiʻi that addresses the growing workforce demand for more certified health care professionals.Program URL: https://westoahu.hawaii.edu/academics/certificates/#health-care-administrationEntry Term: Fall, SpringAvailable: Statewide, Continental U.S., District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam, American SamoaHealth Clearance: ExemptTotal # of Credit Hours: 18Course Format: 15-weeksSchedule: sample-schedule-hcad-cert-woaAttendance Information: No on-campus visits requiredDegree Awarded: CertificateContact:Dr. Kristina LuPhone: (808) 689-2361Email: kguo@hawaii.edu Labor Studies CertificateLabor Studies CertificateUH West OʻahuTurn Your Work Experience Into Power: Earn a Certificate in Labor StudiesLooking to make a difference at work, in your community, or in your future career? The 15-credit Labor Studies Certificate at UH West Oʻahu gives you the tools to understand how labor shapes society—and how you can shape it too.Hawaiʻi has one of the highest union membership rates in the country. From plantation struggles to today's campaigns for equity and fair wages, organized labor has been central to building democracy and justice in the islands. This program invites you to explore that history and step into that legacy.You'll take interdisciplinary courses that connect the dots between work and real life—race, gender, media, politics, economics, and the future of jobs. Learn how labor law affects your rights, how collective bargaining works, and how workers have organized across time and place.Whether you're interested in advocacy, public service, law school, union work, or research, Labor Studies offers a flexible academic pathway with real-world relevance. You'll also develop critical thinking, public speaking, and policy analysis skills—plus get exposure to labor's global dimensions and Hawaiʻi's unique role in it.Stand up. Speak out. Courses cover personal property and liability insurance, life and health insurance, retirement planning, business law, loss prevention, risk retention, self insurance, and risk financing techniques. Students completing the certificate in risk management and insurance will be better prepared to obtain an insurance license and pass the Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) examination and course of study. UH West Oʻahu worked in partnership with Hawaiʻi's insurance industry to create this Risk Management and Insurance certificate specifically to address the growing need for skilled insurance professionals locally and nationwide.Conferral of a Certificate in Risk Management and Insurance does not result in professional licensure. The State Insurance Commissioner requires candidates to pass an examination that measures the applicant's qualifications and competence.
